description: Get the user's collection value broken down by a dimension into slices (each with value, count, and share). Premium-gated. Use get_portfolio_breakdown_cards to drill into one slice. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

by.description: Dimension to break down by. 'cost-basis' buckets are gain/loss/at-cost; 'color' groups by color identity.

colors.description: Only for by=color: comma-separated identity codes (W,U,B,R,G,C; C is colorless) to keep only cards whose color identity contains all of them. Ignored for other dimensions.

name: get_portfolio_breakdown
